title: Task sync informational machine-activity notices
acceptance: Origin-machine activity notices round-trip without exporting claim tokens or becoming local authority, with ordered changes and no renewal chatter, with tests
No TermAl remote relay is introduced, and Greg approves the optional durable activity field before landing; activity-bearing records are not imported into a store served by an old build.

completion.summary: Landed informational task-sync machine activity with stable origin identities, inert round trips, lifecycle revisions and no renewal chatter or remote relay. Clean release installed and origin/master verified. Greg's specific A decision and mixed-build import restriction are recorded. Acceptance changed from revision 2 to 3 under that decision; both revision-3 criteria passed independent evaluation.
